LanguageData.Raven_DivineMilk.label: (Raven) Divine Milk
LanguageData.Raven_DivineMilk.description: An extremely rare mixed milk produced by the Raven race who simultaneously possess dragon and muffalo bloodlines. It emits a golden shimmer, combining the wildness of dragon milk and the mellowness of muffalo milk.\n\nDrinking it not only greatly satisfies nutritional needs, but also provides extremely potent physical and psychological buffs, regarded as a "liquid miracle".
